## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T15:06Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** it is the grade of the closed precedent objectui#12233 (the same base-path remedy). An in-app click works; only a new tab or a copied link answers 404.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui`. Resolve doc-to-doc links through the router basename, as #12233 did.

Claim: PM loop round 7 (`priority:p3`; triage grade `6218424962`)
Session: `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/issue-12686-doc-links-basename`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12686` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: doc-to-doc links in a rendered doc body.
- `apps/console/src/pages/doc-links.ts` (the rewrite of `[x](./other_doc.md)` to a docs route) and `apps/console/src/pages/DocPage.tsx` (the body's click handler, `onContentClick`, near `:114`–`:131` at `main` `6e4f144`): the anchor's `href` carries the router basename, so a new tab, a middle-click or a copied link reaches the doc; a plain left click still navigates in the app; fragment links keep their scroll;
- the remedy is the one objectui#12233 used for record links (`documentHref` / the router's root href), ⛔ not a second join;
- tests beside them;
- one `.changeset/12686-*.md` for `@object-ui/console`.

Outside the surface: the docs routes and their legacy redirect, the book sidebar, the ToC, the markdown sanitizer, and any other link kind.

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: an app-internal href gains the router basename. No prop, export or language-pack key changes.
Responsibility: the console docs portal's body renderer | objectui#12233 fixed the same class on record-page links | every doc-to-doc cross-reference opened in a new tab or copied, under the `/_console` base the console is served at
Thread-read: 6218424962
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `6e4f144`. No open PR names `apps/console/src/pages/doc*` or `DocPage.tsx` (every open PR's file list was read). The last change to `DocPage.tsx` is PR #12538 (merged).

Posted by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`) verbatim from the cloud session's final message, because a cloud session cannot comment from its container. The seat filled `pr` with the draft PR it opened, #12826.

**The seat's answers:**
- **Open question 1 (documentHref): A, `useHref('/docs')`.** The claim's "no second join" meant no hand-built basename join, and react-router's own href is the source `documentHref` copies. Exporting `documentHref` would widen app-shell's surface for no reader. `rewriteDocLinks`' new required parameter is module-internal to the console app (the package publishes `plugin.js` only), so `Clause-②: no` stands.
- **Open question 2 (destination): A, keep the `/docs/NAME` permalink.** `DocsSlug` resolves the book, and the routes are outside the claim.
- **The two observations** are recorded, not filed. The app-scoped reader's cross-references leaving the app shell would be a routes change and needs its own card if anyone reports it; the showcase doc's wording is still true of the router path.
- **The seat read the diff** at `5de6926`: 5 files, +187/−24. `DocPage` reads `useHref('/docs')` once; the click handler hands the router the bare `/docs` path, and its guard for modifier and non-primary clicks is unchanged; on a root mount the behaviour equals today's.
- **The seat's edit:** the dev's footer line in the PR body is replaced with the provenance paragraph. Next: CI on `5de6926`, then the ACCEPT.
